effect: A whole party can no longer be asked again for support on a law through its bench. The already-asked rule (lwC) was per person, and each bench member was a new roll around the forecast, while a yes commits the entire party's line. For lawSupport the check now matches the target's party, so a party answers once on a law from one asker; a person with no recorded party keeps the per-person rule. Other letter types are unchanged. Expected effect: the player's chance of winning a party's support on a law becomes one roll. Day 0 unchanged. No new state. (Minified names in this text are those of build 26403824; the patch's find text has the current ones.)
